subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence.**

She was in a state of **__ecstasy__** when she came to know that her son received a visa on his first attempt.
solution: The correct answer is **"Agony."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Ecstasy"** means extreme happiness or joy. (आह्लाद और आनंद की भावना; हर्षोन्माद) • **Example**: *She threw her head back as if in **ecstasy**__. * • An antonym of **Ecstasy** is **"Agony."** • **"Agony"** means extreme physical or mental suffering, or intense pain. (तीव्र वेदना, तेज़ पीड़ा, व्‍यथा, कष्‍ट) __ • **Example**:* She lay there screaming in **agony**__.* • The correct answer is Option 3. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Abash** means to make someone feel embarrassed or ashamed. (किसी को लज्जित महसूस कराना) • **Inspiration** means something that stimulates or encourages creative thought or action. (कुछ नया करने या सोचने की इच्‍छा उत्‍पन्‍न करने वाला मनोभाव, व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु; प्रेरणा) • **Joyfulness** means a state of great happiness or joy. (अत्यधिक प्रसन्नता या आनंद की अवस्था) 3d:Td8b, The correct answer is **"active."**
